queries.title: Season-to-date KPIs, 2026 vs 2025
queries.purpose: Headline KPIs for closed months (Jan–Sep) per year; validates time intelligence and the GOP join to SAP costs.
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    dim_date[year],
    TREATAS ( { TRUE () }, dim_date[is_closed_ytd] ),
    TREATAS ( { 2025, 2026 }, dim_date[year] ),
    "Occupancy", [Occupancy %],
    "ADR", [ADR],
    "RevPAR", [RevPAR],
    "RevPAR vs LY", [RevPAR vs LY %],
    "Total Revenue", [Total Revenue],
    "GOP Margin", [GOP Margin %],
    "Direct Share", [Direct Share %]
)
ORDER BY dim_date[year]

queries.title: Weakest hotels vs last year and airline seats
queries.purpose: Bottom three hotels by RevPAR growth with the seat change at their airport (TREATAS bridge dim_hotel → dim_airport).
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN (
    3,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        dim_hotel[hotel_name],
        dim_hotel[airport_code],
        TREATAS ( { 2026 }, dim_date[year] ),
        TREATAS ( { TRUE () }, dim_date[is_closed_ytd] ),
        "RevPAR vs LY", [RevPAR vs LY %],
        "Occupancy vs LY (pts)", [Occupancy vs LY (pts)],
        "Airline Seat Growth", [Airline Seat Growth %]
    ),
    [RevPAR vs LY], ASC
)
ORDER BY [RevPAR vs LY] ASC

queries.title: Guest cases at Kyanos Kos Marmari (2026)
queries.purpose: Salesforce case mix for one hotel; surfaces the air-conditioning complaint cluster.
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN (
    4,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        fact_guest_case[sub_category],
        TREATAS ( { "Kyanos Kos Marmari" }, dim_hotel[hotel_name] ),
        TREATAS ( { 2026 }, dim_date[year] ),
        "Cases", [Guest Cases],
        "Avg CSAT", [Avg Case CSAT]
    ),
    [Cases], DESC
)
ORDER BY [Cases] DESC

queries.title: Summer 2027 AI forecast – top movers
queries.purpose: Hotels with the largest forecast occupancy change vs 2026 and their drivers.
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN (
    5,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        dim_hotel[hotel_name],
        "Forecast Occ", [Forecast Occupancy %],
        "2026 Occ", [Last Year Occupancy %],
        "Change (pts)", [Forecast vs LY (pts)],
        "Seat Growth", [Seat Growth at Airport %],
        "Pace vs LY", [Booking Pace vs LY (pts)]
    ),
    [Change (pts)], DESC
)
ORDER BY [Change (pts)] DESC

queries.title: Group-level 2027 outlook
queries.purpose: Single-row summary of the forecast page cards.
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
ROW (
    "Forecast Occ 2027", [Forecast Occupancy %],
    "Actual Occ 2026", [Last Year Occupancy %],
    "On the books", [On-the-Books %],
    "Forecast Room Revenue", [Forecast Room Revenue],
    "vs 2026", [Forecast Room Revenue vs LY %]
)

queries.title: Privilege Club tier mix (2026)
queries.purpose: Stays by Salesforce loyalty tier through dim_guest.
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    dim_guest[loyalty_tier],
    TREATAS ( { 2026 }, dim_date[year] ),
    TREATAS ( { TRUE () }, dim_date[is_closed_ytd] ),
    "Stays", [Bookings]
)
ORDER BY [Stays] DESC

queries.title: GOP margin by hotel concept (2026 vs 2025)
queries.purpose: Profitability by concept combining PMS revenue and SAP costs.
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    dim_hotel[concept],
    TREATAS ( { 2026 }, dim_date[year] ),
    TREATAS ( { TRUE () }, dim_date[is_closed_ytd] ),
    "GOP Margin", [GOP Margin %],
    "GOP Margin LY", [GOP Margin % LY],
    "GOPPAR", [GOPPAR]
)
ORDER BY [GOP Margin] DESC

queries.title: Live PMS – last 24 hours by hotel
queries.purpose: Rolling 24-hour window over the mirrored PMS table (Direct Lake, no refresh needed).
queries.dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN (
    5,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        dim_hotel[hotel_short_name],
        "Bookings 24h", [Bookings Last 24h (live)],
        "Revenue 24h", [Booked Revenue Last 24h (live)]
    ),
    [Bookings 24h], DESC
)
ORDER BY [Bookings 24h] DESC
